title: Compatible MTEXT ASCII scalar conversion bypass
mode: local implementation and focused generated verification
scope: Avoid per-scalar encoded string construction and codepage conversion for compatible MTEXT ASCII scalars
Preserve non-ASCII conversion, UTF-16 conversion, chunk limits, field order, and short-final-group behavior

implementation.change: The compatible MTEXT chunker appends ASCII scalar views directly to its single encoded backing string when the configured converter is not UTF-16; non-ASCII values continue through fromUtf8String.

results.targetTextSelector: PASS: wire=40, rejection/modern=14, chunks=40, framing=4, chunk-preflight-failures=4, empty-chunks=6, short-final=4, compatible-MTEXT=4, borrowed-view=2, uppercase-caps-fast-path=5, profile/caps/raw controls passed

limitations: The bypass is justified by the existing ASCII-preserving converter paths and generated byte/readback controls; no allocation count, throughput, or RSS benchmark was run.
The new route-specific matrix covers ANSI_932 metadata at AC1018 and AC1021 in ASCII and Binary framing; it is not an exhaustive per-codepage matrix.
